name: leankohaku-safenode-bridge
description: TDX-attested oblivious-RPC proxy. Verifies the safe-node enclave at boot, pins the attested TLS public key, and forwards JSON-RPC from a local HTTP endpoint to the upstream ORAM server with strict certificate pinning. Helios's executionRpc points at this sidecar so eth_getProof reads are private (ORAM) AND verified (Helios + the consensus state root).
